name: v0.52.492
body:
## What's Changed
* Release exp-v0.52.459: new chats keep the model's prompt cache (#8150) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8151
* fix(chat): keep the session id out of the system prompt unless asked for (#8148) by @ybai08 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8150
* Release exp-v0.52.460: the same mermaid diagram in two replies renders in both (#8159) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8165
* fix(mermaid): render duplicate diagrams by giving each block a unique render id by @johnDEFI in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8159
* Release exp-v0.52.461: a saved-state update just before a restart is no longer lost (#7859) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8167
* fix(recovery): restore journaled state-saved side effects by @franksong2702 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7859
* Release exp-v0.52.462: the models cache's freshness clock is its build time, not the file's mtime (#7932) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8169
* fix(models): persist and validate _built_at timestamp on models cache (Refs #7723) by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7932
* Release exp-v0.52.463: Feishu and DingTalk chats show up as messaging sessions (#8174) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8175
* Add feishu/dingtalk to MESSAGING_SOURCES so their sessions appear in the WebUI sidebar by @HenryLoveMiller in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8174
* Release exp-v0.52.464: the Memory panel's Project Context and the sidebar project chips are translated (#8178) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8183
* fix(i18n): localize the Memory panel Project Context section and the sidebar project chips, fill the residual ru values (#7579) by @MuhammadUsamaMX in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8178
* Release exp-v0.52.465 (hotfix): chats no longer fail on every message with older Agent builds (#8187) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8188
* fix(streaming): tolerate agents without ToolEntry.dynamic_schema_overrides by @Yi-111-a in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8187
* Release exp-v0.52.466: browser chats honour a profile's OpenRouter provider_routing (#7812) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8191
* fix(webui): forward provider_routing block to in-process chat agents by @TheDevMoth in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7812
* Release exp-v0.52.467: composer chip and sidebar name the served model after a fallback (#7438) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8193
* fix: resolve composer chip and sidebar model label on direct-provider fallback by @Guts1005 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7438
* Release exp-v0.52.468: switching back to a long-running conversation no longer freezes the browser (#8171) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8196
* fix: coalesce reasoning replay renders to prevent UI stalls by @UncleLiu-0306 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8171
* Release exp-v0.52.469: tool calls pair only with an adjacent result (#8194) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8206
* fix(context): pair tool_calls with only an ADJACENT result (split from #7237) by @happy5318 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8194
* Release exp-v0.52.470: metadata-only session reads skip regeneration authority (#8173) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8207
* fix(sessions): skip regeneration authority on metadata-only reads by @tobenot in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8173
* Release exp-v0.52.471: a malformed passkey response is a 400/401, never a 500 (#8138) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8145
* fix(passkeys): a malformed passkey response is a 400/401, never a 500 (#8126) by @ybai08 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8138
* Release exp-v0.52.472: Insights Models card gets 3x width in the usage row (#8157) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8209
* fix(insights): give the Models card 3x width in the usage row by @aleesposito85 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8157
* Release (tag at ship): sign-in works with a malformed foreign cookie (#8124, fixes #8123) [maintainer GO required] by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8136
* parse_cookie: skip malformed cookies instead of dropping the rest of the header by @pcsokonay in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8124
* Release (tag at ship): Enter on a focused control (incl. Deny) no longer approves a pending action (#8131, fixes #8130) [independent review required] by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8134
* fix(approval): Enter on a focused control (incl. Deny) no longer approves a pending action (#8130) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8131
* Release (tag at ship): English Edge TTS voices, title-regenerate error text, sign-in page language (#8210, #8117, #8182) + RFC docs (#7852) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8213
* fix: resolve #2361 — run state consistency authority matrix, invariants 10-11, and layer-named review checklist (docs-only) by @MuhammadUsamaMX in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7852
* fix: #7693 residual — regenerate-title 422 no longer leaks the internal status code by @MuhammadUsamaMX in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8117
* fix: server-rendered /login page honours Accept-Language (#7622 follow-up) by @MuhammadUsamaMX in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8182
* feat(tts): add English multilingual Edge TTS voices to the allowlist and picker by @judah-hermes-agent in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8210
* Release (tag at ship): a finished reply no longer vanishes when the done payload is empty (#7836, fixes #6112) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8220
* fix: #6112 keep the streamed assistant reply through the done settle by @MuhammadUsamaMX in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7836
* Release (tag at ship): faster secret redaction on long values (#8192) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8221
* perf(redaction): skip impossible environment-assignment scans by @tobenot in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8192
* Release (tag at ship): project bindings — pin workspaces and a model to a sidebar project (#6836) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8222
* feat: project bindings — multi-workspace, model and effort by @silent-reader-cn in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6836
* Release (tag at ship): Settings search shows results right away (#6370, fixes #6369) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8225
* fix(settings): render search results while panes load by @yugui923 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6370
* Release (tag at ship): background-subagent wakeups no longer render as user messages (#7882) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8229
* fix(webui): hide async delegation wakeup rows from the chat transcript by @CharlesMcquade in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7882
* Release (tag at ship): git pull timeouts no longer 500 or leak credentials (#8202) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8230
* fix(updates): decode partial output on git timeout so pull failures don't 500 by @happy5318 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8202
* Release (tag at ship): one Agent discovery path for service + bootstrap startup (#7247, fixes #1019) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8231
* fix(#1019): unify Agent runtime discovery by @rodboev in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/7247
* Release (tag at ship): updater recovers from remote-ref name collisions (#8227) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8234
* fix: recover updater remote-ref collisions without pruning local tags by @UncleLiu-0306 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8227
* Release (tag at ship): transcript fixes + render perf from @dss539 (#8218, #8219, #8217) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8236
* perf(ui): reuse Intl formatters for transcript timestamps by @dss539 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8217
* fix(chat): edit, regenerate and fork use a row's current index by @dss539 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8218
* fix(outline): outline jumps land on the message and reuse loaded history by @dss539 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8219
* Release (tag at ship): session save/read perf from @dss539 (#8215, #8216) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8238
* perf(sessions): fingerprint replay rows only when their identity repeats by @dss539 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8215
* perf(sessions): scan session metadata prefixes with a regex tokenizer by @dss539 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8216
* Release (tag at ship): fix the order-dependent credential-pool CI flake (#8237, fixes #8226) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8239
* test(credential-pool): pin the loaded-config path when seeding config in place (fixes #8226) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8237
* Release (tag at ship): cron wrapper follows the Agent's renamed tool (#8201) + WAL test hardening (#8233) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8246
* test: exercise the WAL snapshot refusal proof against the temporary database by @tobenot in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8233
* fix(streaming): install the cron profile wrapper under the renamed cronjob_manage tool by @angel291592 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8201
* Release (tag at ship): virtualized transcripts measure before writing (#8232, fixes #7677) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8247
* fix: resolve #7677 — read-before-write virtual measurement + transparent settle skips the redundant second rebuild (#7677) by @MuhammadUsamaMX in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8232
* Release (tag at ship): case-insensitive /api/ routing (#6589, fixes #3943), security solo by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8248
* fix(api): normalize API path case sensitivity by @webtecnica in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6589
* docs(changelog): stamp v0.52.458 by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8250
* Release (tag at ship): Gateway cancel reconciles the interrupted turn into context (#8166) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8252
* Release (tag at ship): per-turn usage survives a reload (#8258) + session-visit catalog freshness 1 h (#8261) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8262
* fix(streaming): persist per-turn usage on the settled assistant message by @cxk1993 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8258
* perf(models): widen the session-visit disk-cache freshness window to 1h by @cxk1993 in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8261
* Release (tag at ship): draft autosave no longer rewrites the whole session (#6524) by @nesquena-hermes in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/8268
* perf: avoid full session rewrites during draft autosave by @starship-s in https://github.com/nesquena/hermes-webui/pull/6524
